name: Charity Clark
stance: Opposes federal preemption of state AI laws and wants states free to regulate AI harms.

statements.text: AI is a new frontier for consumer protection. With this emerging technology, we need to make sure that elections are protected, consumers are safe from scams, and that our data privacy is preserved.

Signed the 26-attorney-general letter urging Congress to immediately establish federal regulation and safety protocols for frontier AI (mandatory safety testing oversight, incident investigations, international coordination against harmful superintelligence) without preempting state law.
Joined the bipartisan 36-attorney-general NAAG letter urging Congress to reject a federal moratorium preempting state AI laws.
